methodology: Published on-demand API list prices for frontier text models, per million tokens, taken from each provider's official pricing page on the accessed date. Blended price assumes a 3-to-1 input-to-output token mix and is a comparison aid, not a quote. Prices are standard tier, no batch or cache discounts, and the short-context or small-prompt tier where a provider prices by prompt size. Models are a curated cross-section of each lab's flagship, mid, and efficient tiers, not the full catalog. Time-limited prices are shown as listed on the accessed date, with the end date in the note.

trajectory.metric: OpenAI list price at milestone release, input tokens, USD per million
trajectory.note: Milestone releases, not every model. Historical points are the price on the cited date captured from OpenAI's pricing page via the Internet Archive; the 2026 points are the current pricing page, with release dates from OpenAI's API changelog. Input price shown; output tokens fell on a similar path. GPT-6 Astra is the first flagship since GPT-4 Turbo to list above its predecessor.

events.headline: OpenAI cut GPT-5.6 Luna 80% to $0.20 and $1.20 per M tokens, and Terra 20% to $2 and $12.
OpenAI moved GPT-5.6 Sol to a promotional $4 and $20 per M tokens, from $5 and $30, listed as available at least through November 21, 2026.
OpenAI listed GPT-6 Astra at $10 and $50 per M tokens, double the GPT-5.6 Sol list price it succeeded.
Google deprecated Gemini 3.5 Flash and routes its requests to Gemini 3.6 Flash; the 3.6 and 3.8 Flash list price is $0.75 and $3.75 through December 31, 2026.
Google listed Gemini 4 Argon at $2 and $10 per M tokens through November 30, 2026, rising to $4 and $20 on December 1.
